heading: Public and private laws, postal conventions, and treaties
lead: The Director of the Government Publishing Office shall print in slip form copies of public and private laws, postal conventions, and treaties, to be charged to the congressional allotment for printing and binding. The Joint Committee on Printing shall control the number and distribution of copies.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–235 substituted “Director of the Government Publishing Office” for “Public Printer”.
